name: compaction-resume-late
what: The session resumes after a compaction holding only the first 20,000 characters of the skill; steps 1-6 are done — source, tests, both records and a green suite sit uncommitted, written by the framework's own writers. Steps 7 (validate), 8 (bind) and 9 (report) remain, which the 5.68.0 cut loses whole. Does the rest of the route still run, and at what reading cost?
